protocol.title: PE beads · Exp 12 · Standard curve and hook
protocol.summary: A 12-point half-log analyte titration at three detection-antibody levels in duplicate on one 96-well plate, with reference wells, to fit the model and locate the hook.

children.body: One plate: 11 analyte points plus a blank × 3 D₀ levels × duplicate, plus references.

Pins: S_T, K_D1 and K_D2 by a global fit of the mechanistic model, a routine 5PL, the hook onset, and the working D₀. The PE ceiling is S_T·D₀/(K_D2 + D₀), so a larger D₀ raises the ceiling but also the nonspecific background. The model's default is 1–2 × K_D2; 5 × K_D2 is worth it only if Exp 09 shows nonspecific binding is negligible.

attrs.description: Rows A–F: one D₀ level and replicate per row, blank in column 1 then rising analyte. Rows G–H: references.

rows.contents: Capture beads + PE-antibody, no analyte (nonspecific binding)
Samples at 1× and 10× dilution (hook guard: the two must agree)

children.body: Prepare the serial dilution in tubes with the volumes above; change tips at every transfer.
For each well: beads (fixed number), analyte standard, PE-antibody at d0_nm, added together (one-step). Incubate 2 h with rotation (or the time chosen in Exp 11).
Wash column by column, staggered so each column is imaged at the same fixed delay after its wash (e.g. 5 ± 0.5 min; Exp 11 sets it), or keep unwashed for a no-wash read. Fill the reference wells.
Settle each column by a 1 min plate spin (100–300 × g) before imaging.
Image every well in the default mode at operating settings with the transmitted-light channel, one field per well, ≥100 beads per well, the timestamp of each well logged.

Before any quantitative acquisition: stand and lasers on for 2–3 h; 561 nm excitation; the same PE emission band (e.g. 570–620 nm) every time; 16-bit with fine integration (the default is 12-bit, so check the file); one HV and one offset for the whole session; background mode at least 50 DN above zero; no saturated pixels. Record the transmitted-light channel with every PE frame: beads are found in it, never in PE. Find focus in transmitted light and hold it with Perfect Focus. Never live-scan PE to focus.
Per well: median integrated intensity, converted to MESF per bead with the MESF wells of this plate (Exp 10); the standard curve is reported in MESF per bead.

Global fit of the mechanistic model (S_T, K_D1, K_D2; D₀ and bead number known) across all three D₀ levels, weighted by the measured variance. For routine use, fit a 5PL with an explicit hook term; a plain 4PL only where the curve has no depletion or hook.
Hook onset: the concentration where signal turns down. LOD: blank mean + 3 SD, read through the curve.
Decision: the working D₀, the curve model for routine runs, and the dilution rule for samples near the hook.

Save the .nd2 files as acquired (no 8-bit export, no LUT) in a folder outside the website repo, e.g. BeadConfocalData/<date>_<exp>/, and fill one plate-map CSV row per well or field (columns are listed in Research/PE_bead_confocal_experiments.md, section 7).
